svg.text: The last character's query scores its own key and every earlier one's. Softmax

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, 'Liberation Serif', Tinos, 'TeX Gyre Termes', 'Nimbus Roman', serif

svg.text: turns the scores into weights (line width; these are an example) and the head

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, 'Liberation Serif', Tinos, 'TeX Gyre Termes', 'Nimbus Roman', serif

svg.text: takes that mix of their values. Later characters are masked out. Each of the

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, 'Liberation Serif', Tinos, 'TeX Gyre Termes', 'Nimbus Roman', serif

svg.text: 8 heads has its own weights, so each looks for something different.
